A free, open-source planner for Windows and Android. Bring your tasks, calendar, habits, goals and focus sessions together.

Experimental pre-release

A planner for the whole day

Keep your deadlines, planned work, fixed events and actual time separate. Review a Smart Reschedule proposal when plans change and decide whether to apply it.

Tasks and projects

Organize work with categories, subtasks, recurring tasks, search and saved views.

Calendar and scheduling

See fixed events and planned sessions together in day, week and month views.

Habits, goals and focus

Track habits and goals, run a focus timer, log time and review reports.

Themes and widgets

Customize light and dark themes. Keep tasks or your calendar in view with Windows desktop widgets or Android home-screen widgets.

All GitHub releases ↗ Installation and recovery guide ↗

Your data stays local by default

Plan offline without a Todorbit account. Your records live in a local SQLite database. Create local snapshots and review the source and target before restoring.

Your app PIN hides the interface. The database and local recovery files remain unencrypted by Todorbit.

Read the privacy policy ↗

Optional Google Drive Sync

Sync exchanges changes between devices and offers conflict review. Standard Sync uploads readable planner data to your account’s hidden app-data folder. Private Encrypted Sync encrypts data before upload and requires a passphrase or recovery code to unlock a new device.

Independent encrypted backups

Create a point-in-time Google Drive snapshot when you choose. Keep its separate backup passphrase to restore it. A full restore replaces the local database after review.

Google Drive features are experimental. Availability depends on Google account and organization policies.
